findings: Imprecise wording, not an error (AUDIT-1 minor): in context the sentence is true, « for which » referring to Sec. torus's metrics (constant scalar curvature, minimal boundary, and R_g ≤ 0 by prop:nonpositive; clause (3) of Mfd.Reads.rem_conformal_gap proves that reading). Read alone: l.423, second sentence « Sec. torus treats minimal boundaries, for which δ = δ_conf »: minimality alone does not give δ = δ_conf, even with constant scalar curvature. On the two-point toy model with one boundary component, toyConst 100 (R_g ≡ 100, H_g ≡ 0) has Y_[g] < EH, hence δ < δ_conf (rem_conformal_gap_toy_strict). The equality needs the sign R_g ≤ 0 (first sentence, fact (iii)); it holds in Sec. torus because its Setting (l.467) adds constant scalar curvature and prop:nonpositive gives Y_[g] ≤ 0, hence R_g ≤ 0. Proved in that form: Mfd.Reads.rem_conformal_gap (3). A wording correction: « Sec. torus treats constant-scalar-curvature metrics with minimal boundary, for which (Proposition prop:nonpositive) δ = δ_conf ».
questions: The inequality's scope: the remark sits in § 3 for arbitrary g (not necessarily minimal boundary). Reading taken: any g; the model carries Y_[g] > −∞ (BddBelow), which the manifold layer discharges for every bounded mean curvature. If the author intends minimal boundaries only, rem_conformal_gap_le_of_minimal is the hypothesis-free model form.

« Sec. torus treats minimal boundaries » is read as Sec. torus's Setting (constant scalar curvature and minimal boundary, l.467) together with prop:nonpositive's first sentence Y_[g] ≤ 0, carried (its own row); not as minimality alone, which is false (finding).

kb_proposals: Y_[g] > −∞ for a non-minimal boundary on a model reading a compact manifold: Mfd.trace_interp (δ chosen as a_N/(a_N + 4(N−1)·sup|H|·Σ C_j²)) absorbs the boundary term, then hoelder_interior; Mfd.Reads.conformalGap_bddBelow is the reusable form.
In a long proof with many `set` abbreviations, a final nlinarith can time out at whnf on the whole declaration: replace it by an explicit `ring` identity plus linarith.
notes: One file, sorry-free, built alone with `lake build YamabeScaffold.ConformalGap` (no upstream rebuild); #print axioms of every assembly decl: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. The row stays partial on the readings OQ-133 (a)/(b) and OQ-93, as T-yamabe-boundary-gap's; no label is marked.
audit: AUDIT-1 minor: the l.423 finding recorded as imprecise wording, true in Sec. torus's setting (master, at integration).
